from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0149.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
def cls(r,g,b):
    if b>r+40 and b>120: return 'V'
    if r>200 and g>195: return '.'
    if r>185 and g>180: return 'c'
    if r>125 and b<g and r-b>10: return 'f'
    if g>r+15 and g>60: return 'P'
    if r>90 and g<95 and b<80 and r-b>50: return 'w'
    if r<45 and g<48: return '#'
    if r<100: return 'g'
    return '?'
for v in range(256,512,8):
    print(v, ''.join(cls(R[v,u],G[v,u],B[v,u]) for u in range(0,512,6)))
" 2>/dev/null
